text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
This is my confession of a sin unbecoming 
of a saint.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Please hear the confession of a fallen 
saint, who succumbed to temptation and 
indulged in pleasure—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
About a month ago from now, a demon 
suddenly descended upon the town.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"And the devil nested in countless shops, 
manipulating their owners, as its orange 
demonic clutches began to spread."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, so delicious! I could eat this 
forever, Desire-chan.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Gah! That really packs a punch! Next time, 
let's go crazy with the carrot syrup! 
Right, Desire?!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Companions with strong hearts and bodies 
were swallowed up one after another by the 
temptations of hedonism..."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I resisted. As a Saint, I must 
never yield to wicked intentions.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...However, the devil's power was far 
greater than imagined; even the saint's 
prayers could not repel it..."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
My entire body has been overtaken by soft 
shackles, the very symbol of depravity...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
However, my heart has not succumbed to 
evil! In order for me to rise once more as 
a saint, please, lend me your strength!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like a grand tale, but in short, 
she simply overate at various carrot fairs 
and gained weight.
choice_data_list:
...All right. Let's restore the saint's 
former glory.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Thank you. I swear I will cast 
off these wretched shackles.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having confessed her sins honestly, Red 
Desire stuck to the diet menu I supervised 
and successfully returned to her original 
weight.
